chapters.nameEn: Ashta-Dhātu Metallurgical Substrate & Śrī Yantra Geometry
chapters.overview: Interpretive chapter. Lists the eight metals of the aṣṭa-dhātu and the 43 triangles of the Śrī Yantra; the snippet returns those constants (8, 43). No resonance, impedance or metallurgy is computed. Not a remedy and not for ingestion.

slokas.deva:
स्वर्णं रूप्यं ताम्रकं च नागं वङ्गं तथापि च ।
तीक्ष्णं कान्तं च रसकं ह्यष्टधातु प्रकीर्तितम् ॥
slokas.translit:
svarṇaṃ rūpyaṃ tāmrakaṃ ca nāgaṃ vaṅgaṃ tathāpi ca |
tīkṣṇaṃ kāntaṃ ca rasakaṃ hyaṣṭadhātu prakīrtitam ||

anvaya.en: Are declared as the sacred Ashta-Dhatu

slokas.translation: Gold, Silver, Copper, Lead, Tin, Iron, Magnetite, and Zinc constitute the eight sacred metals known as Ashta-Dhatu.
slokas.source: स्रोत अपरीक्षित · source unverified — no text in this repository carries this verse; it is not presented as a located quotation. Annex verse: not presented as a classical text.

chapters.nameSa: पुष्पक विमान भौतिकी एवं डमरू तरङ्ग-शास्त्र
chapters.nameEn: Pushpaka Vimāna Aerodynamic Physics & Ḍamaru Acoustic Waves
chapters.overview: Interpretive chapter. Pairs the vimāna of the Vaimānika tradition with the standing-wave formula fₙ = n v ⁄ 2L for n = 1…14; the snippet returns constants (1.618, 14) and computes no aerodynamics.

slokas.deva:
पक्षोद्घातेन मरुतां वेगं सम्पाद्य खे गतिम् ।
नादब्रह्ममये पीठे विमानं परिकीर्तितम् ॥
slokas.translit:
pakṣodghātena marutāṃ vegaṃ sampādya khe gatim |
nādabrahmamaye pīṭhe vimānaṃ parikīrtitam ||

anvaya.en: Upon the platform of acoustic wave resonance

slokas.translation: By inducing differential atmospheric velocity, movement through the sky is achieved upon the foundation of acoustic wave dynamics.
slokas.source: स्रोत अपरीक्षित · source unverified — no text in this repository carries this verse; it is not presented as a located quotation. Annex verse: not presented as a classical text.

formula.title: Acoustic Standing Wave Harmonic Frequency
formula.latex: f_n = \frac{n v}{2 L}, \quad n = 1, 2, \dots, 14 \quad (\text{14 Śivasūtra Harmonics})
formula.notes: c_l = 1.618 is a constant written in the snippet; no lift or vortex is computed.

chapters.nameEn: Geodetic Triangulation of 51 Śakti Pīṭhas & 12 Jyotirliṅgas
